description: All five evidence categories must have at least one entry or an explicit justified n/a before Phase 4 to 5.
Every fact requires a linked evidence reference before it can be saved.
Decision and finding records cannot rely on post-event information without justification.
Each major finding requires at least one contradicting evidence row before Phase 5 to 6.
Phase 6 to 7 hard-block if all roots are personal factors and no Lack-of-Control entry exists.
Warn when causes cluster in hardware-only categories and system factors may be under-coded.
Warn when causes cluster in person-only categories and process or organisational factors may be under-coded.
Warn when causes cluster in external-event categories and internal controls may be under-coded.
